title: Kushner Meets Netanyahu in Israel in Effort to Break Logjam Over Gaza
summary_full: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel has refused to pull back the country’s military until Hamas fully disarms. But the Trump administration is under pressure to show progress.
